description: Convert UTC to Argentine local at every Blazor date-display site so users see Argentine time instead of raw UTC. Depends on FEAT-001 (uses ArgentinaTimeZone.ToLocal). Independent of FEAT-002 in code, but ordered after it. Date-picker defaults stay browser-local; the yyyy-MM-dd values sent to the API stay unchanged (the backend now interprets them as Argentine local).
steps: Add `@using SistemaAlmacen.Shared.Common` to each affected .razor (or to _Imports.razor once if present) and wrap each API-sourced date in ArgentinaTimeZone.ToLocal(...) before ToString.

src/SistemaAlmacen.Client/Pages/Reportes/Reportes.razor: `dia.Fecha` is already an Argentine-local day after FEAT-002, so format it directly (do NOT call ToLocal again). Leave the `_fechaInicio`/`_fechaFin` pickers and the `yyyy-MM-dd` query strings unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: dotnet build SistemaAlmacen.slnx succeeds (Client compiles with the new @using and helper calls).
Every listed view formats API-sourced dates via ArgentinaTimeZone.ToLocal except Reportes.razor dia.Fecha (already local).
Date-picker defaults (DateTime.Today) and outbound yyyy-MM-dd filter strings are unchanged.
verification: Run `dotnet build SistemaAlmacen.slnx` and confirm success.
Run `dotnet test SistemaAlmacen.slnx` and confirm all tests pass.
findings: Added `@using SistemaAlmacen.Shared.Common` once to src/SistemaAlmacen.Client/_Imports.razor (no per-file @using needed since the helper is now in scope for every .razor). Wrapped each API-sourced date in ArgentinaTimeZone.ToLocal(...) at the seven display sites: HistorialVentas.razor (v.Fecha), DetalleVenta.razor (_venta.Fecha), HistorialCompras.razor (c.Fecha), DetalleCompra.razor (_compra.Fecha), CajaPage.razor (_cajaAbierta.FechaApertura and mov.Fecha), and HistorialCierres.razor (cierre.FechaApertura, cierre.FechaCierre, mov.Fecha). Left Reportes.razor dia.Fecha formatted directly (already Argentine-local after FEAT-002, not double-converted) and left all date-picker defaults (DateTime.Today) and outbound yyyy-MM-dd filter strings unchanged. Verification: `dotnet build SistemaAlmacen.slnx` succeeded (only pre-existing NU19xx/CS86xx warnings, no errors); `dotnet test SistemaAlmacen.slnx` passed 25/25 tests with 0 failures.
